description: Expected observations for the desktop walking-skeleton native smoke (run.mjs). Values come from T3's G10 checklist (a jsdom replay of the same models); they are not re-pinned from a native run. The bundled invented demo has nonlinear supports, so under K-D5 (DEL-04-01 Design/kd5-member-relative-bound.md §5, "The nonlinear-support route") its converged cases are published NUMERICAL_INTEGRITY_SENSITIVE with the route's named sentence, and its rows stay today's binary64 rows (625 sparse, 627 dense). A Sensitive result is not Current, so the product offers no result export for either case (the milestone was already Sensitive): `result_export` gives the export panel's text, and `stored_run_integrity` the named Sensitive standing the saved demo run carries. The model hash is computed by run.mjs from each file (RFC 8785 JCS, SHA-256), independently of the app.
